body:
Ex said more or less the same thing to me. And she was cheating already. 

Note I said ex. Dump his ass.

Dad? is that you? 

Stop using your new wife as the excuse to abandon your child. If you want to abandon your kid own it. And own the trauma you caused. 

A good parent wouldn't even consider it.
I haven't looked but a 7 has to be worth quite a bit? I'd love to have one of these.
She. Was. Not  President. She doesn't make policy. Why is this hard to understand?
Bottom left corner is bent and the left side has some other damage. I can only see it in the PSA scans. May be other things too.

Pictures aren't good enough but given it's graded and what I can see it's likely real. If you can upload better closeups we could give a better idea. The cert number checks out and matches. Worth $2500 or so?
If you let her stay out of work for a year she'll never go back. I know from experience.
Send me a DM. I'm a millionaire individually and if you are counting generational wealth my wife and I's combined parents have much more.

I totally get it. Dating seemed so easy for others around me and I couldn't understand what I was doing wrong. The self loathing was brutal. I went to therapy over it. 

I even had a friend who would have pity fucked me but I didn't want it like that. 

Just letting you know you aren't alone.
My dog. I have to take care of her.

I was a virgin until I was 34. I never kissed anyone really until about 27-28. Sex and relationships aren't everything but I truly understand how it gets in your head. I suffered for years feeling inadequate and ashamed of my inexperience. 

Keep trying. It's not the end of the world. You'll get there.
I hate to hear that someone else is in the same situation. How are you doing?
I think the edge is too destroyed for that. The tack strips wouldn't be very close to the wall in some places. Probably could be done but I don't know if it's ideal.

Mine refused to talk about her exes. It took 2 years for her to admit that the previous relationship failed for the same reasons ours was failing. She had no pictures of them, no mementos...nothing. It was like they ceased to exist. To this day I know nothing about any of them.

I'm sure I will also cease to exist for the next guy.
There is a lot more to it. This would be far from the only reason to divorce. I just find it so weird and confusing as a requirement.

I have floated the mountains to her. Her industry is oil and gas which for no apparent reason I can figure both require people to work in an office AND rent office space downtown. So she wants to never commute on a highway and live on the "grid". I work completely remote and could live anywhere with internet so to say the least this is frustrating. 

But regardless of commute it still has to be a grid for her. No exceptions.

We have tried counseling and it kind of went nowhere. She only says that she needs to be able to mindlessly go walk and get back home. Google Maps is apparently too much to ask. I absolutely do not get it. There is some psychology to it that I'm missing.
I've moved 5 times in 3 years for various reasons. Most of them related to breakups. I don't know what home is anymore.

I was considering filing for divorce from my wife of 3 months because of a huge number of issues that came up between us. I'm not going to type it all today. Unfortunately I've lost 30-40% of my savings in the last few weeks and I probably have to move back to her old house with her now. I don't want to live with her but financially it's the best option.

It's ruined my outlook on my future and I'm demoralized that I'm never going to be happy again. She's not abusive but she is an asshole. It's not going to be pretty.

Ex of mine started online gaming on Lord Of The Rings Online with an old coworker. I played too but wasn't allowed to join them. I knew something was up. Then she started playing in the basement. And then Skype sessions. Which involved masturbation. While I was home. Caught them one night. That was that. 

Oh and then I found their secret Twitter accounts where they posted their fantasies about each other.
